name: PanCode
summary: The harness: plans a task, runs it on the models you connect, contains every command and checks the result.

name: PanStore
title: PanStore: keep results outside the working tree
description: PanStore keeps a project's datasets and results outside the working tree, each file recorded with who put it, from where, and its hash.
summary: A project store for results and datasets, outside the working tree, with a record of where each file came from.

name: PanKit
title: PanKit: MCP tool servers for HPC and science
description: PanKit serves seven MCP tool servers for node facts, modules, Spack, Darshan, scientific data, dataset catalogs and the project store.
summary: Seven MCP tool servers for node facts, modules, Spack, Darshan, scientific data, catalogs and the store.

name: PanHub
title: PanHub: the packs bundled with PanCode
description: Every PanHub pack bundled with this PanCode release: skills, plugins and extensions, each with its tier, licence, source and install command.
summary: Installable packs of skills, plugins and extensions, each pinned by the SHA-256 of its whole tree.

name: PanSDK
title: PanSDK: write extensions, packs and tools
description: PanSDK is the typed surface for writing PanCode extensions, packs, tools and MCP servers, imported from pancode/sdk and licensed Apache-2.0.
summary: Types and helpers for writing extensions, packs, tools and MCP servers, imported from pancode/sdk.
